WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    sp.zoneref,
    s.insurstat,
    AVG(sp.remaingb) as avg_remaingb,
    AVG(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu) as avg_cpu_minus_gpu
  FROM scanprocessing sp
  JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remaingb) as mean_remaingb
  FROM group_stats
  WHERE avg_remaingb IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  gs.zoneref,
  gs.insurstat,
  gs.avg_remaingb,
  gs.avg_cpu_minus_gpu,
  CASE 
    WHEN gs.avg_remaingb IS NOT NULL
    THEN gs.avg_remaingb / om.mean_remaingb
    ELSE NULL
  END as ratio
FROM group_stats gs
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE om.mean_remaingb IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
